Class Gojo

java.lang.Object
game.entities.towers.Tower
game.entities.towers.Gojo
public class Gojo extends Tower
Implements a high-utility tower featuring tiered ability priorities and various area-of-effect (AOE) attacks. The tower logic transitions from single-target strikes to multi-phase magical techniques based on upgrade progression.
